title: Space Impact II on GameShell
desc: A GameShell port of a pixel-perfect clone of Nokia's Space Impact II, with handheld controls and a launcher installer.

title: LowRes NX on GameShell & PocketCHIP
desc: Custom builds of the LowRes NX fantasy console: the GameShell build fixes the display resolution and adds a launcher entry; a PocketCHIP build too.

title: PegasusG by ROC (H700 handhelds)
desc: Features for the H700 build of this GBA frontend, merged upstream: system and quick-settings menus, offline Chinese/pinyin search with a controller keyboard, native-resolution layouts, separate frontend/system volume, standby modes and Docker builds.

title: Godot games on GameShell
desc: Getting Godot games running on the GameShell handheld, written up step by step.

title: LÖVE 11.3 on PocketCHIP
desc: Building and installing LÖVE 11.3 on PocketCHIP, so LÖVE games run on it.

title: RetroArch on PocketCHIP
desc: RetroArch built for PocketCHIP, with the install steps written up.

title: freemind.bithack Hugo theme
desc: The dark, terminal-style Hugo theme this blog runs on: a port of hexo-theme-freemind.bithack with pixel fonts, search, reader mode and bilingual support. No Node needed.
